newsitem.title: USA: Consumat names Peter Socha chairman.
newsitem.headline: Consumat names Peter Socha chairman.

text.p: Consumat Environmental Systems Inc said on Thursday it named Peter Socha a director and chairman of the board.
Socha, who was vice president of Sirrom Capital Corp in Tennessee, would receive a nominal salary of $1 and options to buy common stock in the company, Consumat said.
Sirrom provided $1.5 million in financing to the company during 1995 and 1996, enabling it to successfully emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings.
Sirrom received warrants to buy 250,000 shares of common stock in the company, as part of the financing, it said.
The company was not immediately available to comment on who Socha was replacing.
